title: The half hey crosses the lines
assumes: The half hey is the crossing: you weave out of your own line and stop on the other one, and the balance and swing that follows is danced from the new side.
quotes: A2  (7) N2 neighbor allemande right 1 & 1/4  (9) Hey 1/2 (WL;PR;ML;N2R)
notes: Written on both passes, because Anna's Reel is a two-pass record and the set progresses at the end of each pass.
